create_tcp_proxy: create a TcpProxy instance to proxy TCP traffic between a client and server for testing
start_tcp_proxy: start the TcpProxy to begin forwarding bytes between a connected client and gateway server
get_byte_count: get the sent and received byte counts from a running TcpProxy for traffic analysis
stop_tcp_proxy: stop the TcpProxy and close all associated sockets and threads cleanly
use_tcp_proxy_context_manager: use TcpProxy as a context manager to auto start and stop the proxy in a with block
